newsitem.title: USA: Garden Botanika Jan same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Garden Botanika Jan same-store sales rise.

text.p: Garden Botanika Inc on Wednesday said its same-store sales in January rose 22 percent, while total sales jumped 49 percent.
Total January sales of $6.9 million were generated at 253 stores, compared with 152 open in the same month of 1996, when total sales were $4.7 million.
For the 52-week period ended February 1, same-store sales rose six percent, and total sales rose 67 percent to $92.5 million.
The company -- a retailer of personal-care products -- said it planned to open about 50 stores in 1997.
